name: pilot-harness
title_zh: 把 DeepSeek 装进桌面，像 CodePilo
tagline_zh: 厌倦了网页端来回切标签？这套桌面客户端+插件套件，让 DeepSeek 驻留本地，三平台通吃，快捷键直达。
tagline_en: Tired of tab-hopping in the browser? This desktop client + plugin suite keeps DeepSeek local, cross-platform, and.
desc_en: Pilot Harness — a CodePilot-inspired desktop client and plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
why_zh: 不是套壳网页，而是真桌面集成：插件体系可扩展，快捷键与系统原生交互，把模型能力嵌进日常操作流。
why_en: Not a web wrapper—real desktop integration with a plugin system, native hotkeys, and system-level interactions. It embeds the.
limit_zh: 需要自备 DeepSeek API key 和网络；仅覆盖桌面端交互，不处理移动端或云端同步；插件生态尚浅。
limit_en: Requires your own DeepSeek API key & internet; desktop-only, no mobile/cloud sync; plugin ecosystem is young—complex automation needs manual config.
